title: The folds and cusps of the perturbed complex square
statement: For the real smooth map \(F_\varepsilon:\mathbb C\to\mathbb C\), \(F_\varepsilon(z)=z^2+\varepsilon\bar z\), \(\varepsilon>0\), determine the critical set, critical values, local singularity types, and the regular-fibre cardinalities.
status: As of 9 November 2026: settled. The critical circle is \(|z|=\varepsilon/2\); its image is the three-cusped curve \(\varepsilon^2(e^{2it}/4+e^{-it}/2)\), with cusps where \(e^{3it}=1\) and folds elsewhere. There are four preimages in its interior and two in its exterior. The explicit treatment is \citet[\S1, Example 6, pp.~4--5]{arnold1968singularities}, published in 1968 from 1966 lectures. This repeats the earlier indexed question; it does not create a new problem.
